indicator_name: Estimated malaria incidence (per 1000 population at risk)
definition: Estimated new malaria cases in a year per 1,000 population at risk.

indicator_name: Measles-containing-vaccine second-dose (MCV2) immunization coverage by the locally recommended age (%) (WUENIC)
definition: Measles-containing vaccine second-dose coverage by the locally recommended age (%), WHO/UNICEF estimates of national immunization coverage (WUENIC).

indicator_name: Incidence of tuberculosis (per 100 000 population per year)
definition: Estimated new and relapse tuberculosis cases in a year per 100,000 population, including cases among people living with HIV.
Expected years of life from birth under the prevailing age- and sex-specific mortality conditions.
Expected equivalent years in full health from birth under the prevailing age- and sex-specific mortality and morbidity conditions.

indicator_name: Adult mortality rate (probability of dying between 15 and 60 years per 1000 population)
definition: Probability that a person aged 15 dies before age 60 under the reporting year's mortality conditions, expressed per 1,000.
Number of reported measles cases in a year; a case count, not an incidence rate.

indicator_name: Diphtheria tetanus toxoid and pertussis third-dose  (DTP3) immunization coverage among 1-year-olds (%) (WUENIC)
definition: DTP-containing vaccine third-dose coverage among one-year-olds (%), WHO/UNICEF estimates of national immunization coverage (WUENIC).
Measles-containing vaccine first-dose coverage among one-year-olds (%), WHO/UNICEF estimates of national immunization coverage (WUENIC).
